MOD = 1000000007

def add_numbers(a, b):
    sum_ = a + b
    if sum_ >= MOD:
        sum_ -= MOD
    return sum_

def main():
    n = int(input())
    dp = [0] * (n + 2)
    dp[0] = 1
    total_sum = 0
    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            if (i + j) % 2 == 1:
                total_sum = add_numbers(total_sum, dp[j])
            dp[j + 1] = add_numbers(dp[j + 1], dp[j])
    print(total_sum)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
